description: For one tournament, gender, age and flight: every group and team, each matched to its real league team with a confidence label (Confirmed, Strong match, Likely match, or Check: can't confirm accuracy) and the evidence, its level (Elite or Competitive), W-D-L, goal difference, rank where ranked, league link, and a count of elite and competitive teams in the flight. Leave out gender, age or flight to get the list of choices. Pass a tournament id from pitch/find-tournament or an Athletes2Events event URL.

flight.description: Flight name as the tournament labels it, such as "Flight 1", or its id.

name: pitch-scout-tournament
title: Scout a tournament bracket (Tournament Scout)
